FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 73
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Economic Development
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/19/2025
Senate Bill 73 as introduced could decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the additional amounts contributed to catastrophe savings
accounts due to the increase caps on contributions provided by this bill.
